name.description: Plugin name (kebab-case); becomes the /<name>:<skill> invocation namespace

description.description: Short plugin description for the marketplace listing

skills.description: Skill slugs (a bare slug resolves against the invoking user's own home directory, under .claude/skills/<slug>) or paths to skill directories to bundle into the plugin

version.description: Optional semver; omit to let Claude Code auto-version from the git commit SHA

owner.description: Marketplace owner display name; defaults to git config user.name at draft time
